  const dragTransfer = new DataTransfer(); dragTransfer.items.add(note);
  nativeForm.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent("dragenter", { dataTransfer: dragTransfer, cancelable: true }));
  nativeForm.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent("dragleave"));
  check(!nativeForm.classList.contains("file-drag"), "drag highlight clears when dragleave has no file types");
  nativeForm.remove(); window.agenthubDesktop = originalDesktop;
  input("s", "이미지와 파일을 함께 검토해 주세요."); files("s", [image("preview.png"), note]);
  await until(() => $("s-attachments").querySelector("img").complete);
  // 세션에 연결된 오류는 "AI에게 해결 요청"으로 동작 · 원인 · 해결 방법 · 원문 일부를 일반 메시지로 보낸다.
  const { showError } = await import("/shared/error-report.js");
  const plain = showError({ message: "fixture plain failure" }, { action: "fixture 확인" });
  check(!plain.querySelector(".error-report-ask") && plain.querySelector(".error-report-action").textContent === "fixture 확인 실패", "errors without a session hide the AI request button");
  plain.querySelector(".error-report-close").click();
  const asked = await count("/messages");
  const toast = showError({ message: "fixture git failure", hint: "fixture hint", raw: "fixture raw line", reason: "git-dirty" }, { action: "fixture 커밋", sessionId: "s1" });
  check(toast.querySelector(".error-report-hint").textContent.includes("fixture hint") && toast.querySelector(".error-report-raw pre").textContent === "fixture raw line", "error toast shows hint and folded raw output");
  toast.querySelector(".error-report-ask").click();
  await until(async () => await count("/messages") === asked + 1 && toast.querySelector(".error-report-status").textContent.includes("요청"));
  const request = (await requests()).filter((r) => r.path.endsWith("/s1/messages")).at(-1);
  check(["fixture 커밋", "fixture git failure", "fixture hint", "fixture raw line", "해결해 주세요"].every((part) => request.body.prompt.includes(part)) && !request.body.mode, "AI request sends the error as a normal session message");
  toast.remove();
  return checks;
})()
